description: Choose which HubSpot forms Doorman screens on a connected HubSpot account. Replaces the current list. form_id "new" makes a lead form named like the HubSpot form. Each submission's verdict is then written onto the HubSpot contact as doorman_verdict (Real, Held, Kept out).

api_key.description: Doorman API key (dm_live_...). Only needed if the MCP connection has no Authorization header.

forms.description: Every HubSpot form Doorman should screen; an empty list stops screening this account's forms

form_id.description: f_... of an existing Doorman form, or "new"

workspace_id.description: Optional ws_...: put a new form in this client workspace

portal_id.description: The HubSpot account id (portal_id from doorman_hubspot_status)

name: doorman_hubspot_map_forms
